title: Tasks
subtitle: Give a staff member a job with a note. They send a resolve request when it is done, and it counts as resolved only after you verify it.

empty.resolve_requested: Nothing is waiting for you to verify.
empty.resolved: No task has been resolved yet.

form.newDesc: The staff member gets a notification on their phone.
form.editDesc: You can change the wording and due date until the staff member says it is done.
form.branchHelp: Staff who work in more than one branch appear in each of them; the task is kept under the branch you pick.
form.noStaff: No active field staff in this branch.
form.title: What needs to be done
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Collect the shop key from Karim
form.noteHelp: Where to go, who to ask, what to bring back. This is not tied to a customer.

errors.past: The due date cannot be in the past.

verify.title: Verify and resolve?
verify.desc: {{who}} says "{{task}}" is done. After you confirm it is resolved and the staff member is told.

reject.title: Send this task back?
reject.desc: "{{task}}" goes back to {{who}}. They see the reason and can send a new request.

cancel.title: Cancel this task?
cancel.desc: "{{task}}" for {{who}} is withdrawn and cannot be reopened. They are told.

stale: This task changed while you were looking at it. The list was refreshed.
